questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: You register with your Learning agreement, and you can change that up to 2 months in. They don't have a course catalogue available online, and they don't send a course catalogue to you. On the day of the  deadline we were shown the course catalogue.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Be proactive and asking yourself.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Successful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Talk with the administration

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: It was a pretty good level, we mostly read research papers and was presented their models and the like.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was horrible, they don't do breaks. You have to sit down for maybe 1h30m a lecture  and then you're late for your next lecture which has already started and sometimes this can go on from 1400h to 1900h.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Macroeconomics, Valuing the Environment, Sustainable development, Fundamentals and policies for a greener economy, market power and regulation, causal inference with observational data.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: All.
